name: Failure Evidence Guard
summary: Normalize failed tool calls into bounded, non-sensitive evidence for the next model step.
description: A deterministic fail-open PostToolUseFailure observer that classifies a tool failure and adds a small corrective receipt without copying raw error or command content.
refuses: It does not retry, repair, rerun, or reinterpret the failed operation.
It does not copy raw commands, tool inputs, stack traces, or error text into added context.
It does not claim that a failure category establishes the root cause.
It does not block the session when evidence cannot be normalized.

entrypoints.purpose: Classify a failed tool call and inject a bounded, content-safe failure receipt.
